headline: Kazakhstan's Ministry of Ecology Will Lead the Country's Transition to Alternative Energy Sources and Hydrogen
summary: Kazakhstan's new plan to reach carbon neutrality by 2060 includes energy sector reform and mandatory business reporting. The Ministry of Ecology will lead the country's transition to alternative energy sources and hydrogen.
why: Energy transition policy and carbon targets shape investment in power generation, hydrogen and reporting obligations for Kazakh companies, particularly in the fossil-heavy energy sector.
